definitionOfDone: useDLQ() list DLQ entries with pagination
DLQEntry type in api/types.ts if not defined

implementationPlan.description: Create dashboard/src/hooks/useDLQ.ts: useDLQ(filters?) fetching GET /api/v1/dlq with pagination. useRetryDLQ() mutation (POST /api/v1/dlq/:id/retry, accepts optional pool override). useRetryDLQBatch() mutation (POST /api/v1/dlq/retry with body { ids: string[] }). useDeleteDLQ() mutation (DELETE /api/v1/dlq/:id). useDeleteDLQBatch() mutation (POST /api/v1/dlq/delete with body { ids: string[] }). All mutations invalidate ['dlq'] and ['dlq', 'nav'] caches.
